job: Turn a setting on or off, with the change applying at once.
purpose: A real checkbox with role="switch": off is a faint ink track, on is the accent. The thumb slides with a slight spring and stretches while pressed. A switch has no Save button. A setting that cannot be turned off is shown locked, with the reason beside it.
useWhen: A setting takes effect the moment it flips: notifications, a feature flag, a preference.
The label reads as a state: "Email me when a run fails".

avoidWhen.when: The change needs confirming or saves with a form.
There are three or more states.
One option of several is chosen and the other is not "off".
A grid of categories by channels needs a switch in every cell.

states.name: locked
states.how: data-locked on the switch, with a fd-switch-lock reason

variants.useWhen: The label sits before the track, as in a row with the control at the end.
The setting cannot be changed; say why in fd-switch-lock.

parts.role: The label that wraps the input.
The reason a locked switch cannot change.
